**Verified current (2026-11-05, fresh `gh` reads):** issue #5851 is OPEN, filed 2026-11-05T01:55:56Z in the WS-F gap pass, carrying only `task/triage` + `queue/queued` + `app/id` at claim time — no hard-stop labels (`held`, `user/owned`, `do-not-merge`, `do-not-auto-edit`), no competing PR or branch, and no other issue references issue #5851 yet (search of `5851 in:body` returns nothing), so no duplicate or superseding work exists.

Its body is explicit that the parent *fixes* the input this design must compose with (the semantic markup + style-assertion model by which programs-as-websites render across web, native, and custom targets) and must not re-decide it. The issue stays open under programme epic issue #2056, labelled triaged + waiting-dependency to mirror this ordering. No code change in this triage.
